style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft daylight girls tulle-dress visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm tulle paper #FCF7F4, studio blush-greige field #EFE1DE, walnut plank ground #6E4C33 doubling as the ink colour for every line and label, and one berry-rose accent #8E3B52 used only as a hairline rule, one petal tick or one outline and never as a field; neutral-warm daylight around 5000K filtered through a draped sheer veil from the upper right with a bounce fill on the shadow side, one soft tulle-filtered gradient band across the ground and a true contact shadow under every hem; recurring background system of blush-greige paper, warm tulle paper and walnut plank with one arched opening in a draped sheer veil as the only headline container; modern geometric sans-serif throughout plus one light wide-tracked small-cap rail inside the arch, no second typeface and no oversized wall word; layout built from scalloped-wave-edge paper cards, quatrefoil outline icon cells with blank centres and one berry-rose hairline rule per screen; the sheer overlay and the opaque lining always read as two layers at one stable scale, every worn frame a generic child cropped from the neck down or seen from behind with no identifiable face; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no outdoor street scenery and no showroom furniture, no inconsistent lighting and no missing contact shadows, no circular photo masks, no round magnifier windows, no taped cards, no contact sheets and no seal or badge artwork, no legible characters, numerals or years inside any graphic zone, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

style.presentationRules: the sheer overlay and the opaque lining always read as two layers at one scale and hero scale never shifts more than five percent between screens; the neckline band, the shoulder yoke seam, the turned-back sleeve cuff, the single-row back placket, the waist bow zone and the scattered motif zones are named structurally and never redrawn; every worn frame is a generic child model cropped from the neck down, seen from behind or shot below the shoulders, never an identifiable face, never adult proportions or styling; cards stay square to the frame and the arched veil window is the only headline container
style.surfaceSystem: walnut plank board and bench #6E4C33 as the only furniture-grade surface, warm tulle paper #FCF7F4 used both as backdrop and as the stock of every scalloped card, blush-greige paper floor #EFE1DE under worn frames; a draped sheer veil sits as a foreground layer where named; garment faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free, the scalloped lining edge stays crisp, no debris in frame
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label plus one light wide-tracked small-cap rail reserved for the arched veil window; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-46pt, subline 14-18pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; no serif, no brush lettering, no handwritten script, no outline lettering and no oversized wall word
